Reproducibility of results and easy availability of code will be taken into account in the decision-making process.\n\n## Code and Data Submission\n\nAuthors should not include links to non-anonymized repositories; instead, they should submit the code base itself or anonymized repositories. ICML 2026 supports the submission of two kinds of supplementary material: supplementary manuscripts and code/data, and authors have the option of uploading extra files as Supplementary Material to provide further details of their work (e.g., code/data that supports experimental findings).\n\n## General Submission Standards\n\nAll claims must be clearly stated and supported by reproducible experiments and/or sound theoretical analysis. Authors must include necessary disclosures, ensure data integrity, and cite prior work responsibly.\n\nFor more detailed information, you can consult the official ICML 2026 Author Instructions at icml.cc/Conferences/2026/AuthorInstructions.\n\n\nREMINDER: You MUST include the sources above in your response to the user using markdown hyperlinks."}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"2aaff89b-05ca-4357-a944-5f88570005e7","uuid":"1c6432f0-04ef-4e8c-9b8a-660939f04b4a","timestamp":"2026-05-27T22:35:54.973Z","tool_use_result":{"query":"ICML 2026 paper submission checklist reproducibility requirements","results":[{"tool_use_id":"srvtoolu_013PK3SFFvMDgiwhMFs1kgNt","content":[{"title":"All You Need to Know About ICML 2026 Registration and Submission Deadlines! - Perplexed","url":"https://www.perplexe.net/conference/all-you-need-to-know-about-icml-2026-registration-and-submission-deadlines/"},{"title":"ICML 2026 Author Instructions","url":"https://icml.cc/Conferences/2026/AuthorInstructions"},{"title":"ICML 2026: Strictest New Rules Ever - LLMs Banned as Authors, Papers with AI Abuse Rejected","url":"https://eu.36kr.com/en/p/3540848514510723"},{"title":"ICML 2026 Reviewer Instructions","url":"https://icml.cc/Conferences/2026/ReviewerInstructions"},{"title":"ICML 2026 Call for Papers","url":"https://icml.cc/Conferences/2026/CallForPapers"},{"title":"ICLR 2026 Author Guide","url":"https://iclr.cc/Conferences/2026/AuthorGuide"},{"title":"Call for Papers: AISTATS 2026","url":"https://virtual.aistats.org/Conferences/2026/CallForPapers"}]},"Based on the search results, here's what I found about ICML 2026 paper submission checklist and reproducibility requirements:\n\n## Reproducibility Requirements\n\nA reproducibility checklist is required, outlining datasets, code availability, and experimental details to support verification of results.
